content:
dc18e9140 Added GNUTLS_BAG_SECRET that adds support for storing a randomly generated key into a PKCS-12 structure. This is a gnutls extension, since PKCS-12 does not specify what should be in the secret bag. What we do is store the key as OCTET string and specify an OID of the PKCS-9 random nonce.
4168761ce Added stuff needed to read PKCS #12 bag attributes.
7184b2996 Several more additions to PKCS #12 to allow encrypting bags. Still not interoperable.
703714d0f Some changes in PKCS12 to allow a bag to hold more than one elements.
